## Checklist
- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check .` pass

- [ ] If an e-mail's look changed: the README's pictures regenerated (`scripts/demo_screenshots.py`)
- [ ] No real statement, card number, name, address, phone number or e-mail address anywhere in the change
